items: Settings has a Check for updates button, so you can get a new version straight away.
Fixed: the app again stores itself on the phone, so it opens without internet and updates itself.

title: The whole dictionary
items: The app now uses the full database: 5,364 signs, 31,643 words and 47,087 sentences from 7,405 texts.
The first start downloads the dictionary once (about 66 MB, so Wi-Fi is a good idea). After that it opens from the copy on your phone, also without internet.
Signs from Unicode's extended list are now shown with the NewGardiner font.
After an update, this window shows what has changed.

title: New version of the app
items: A menu with History, Help and Settings (the button at the top right).
Recently used signs on the keyboard.
Hold a finger on what you have written to magnify it and move the cursor.
Sort menus in the Dictionary and in Saved.
The app now updates itself when a new version is published.
